instructions_to_main_agent: Build fully functional system with public real estate website, Associate Portal, and Admin Portal in React JS (.js files).
Public website routes: Home, Projects, Properties, Gallery, About Us, Contact, and Book Site Visit.
Customer flow: browse projects, submit inquiry, request site visit, associate contact, reservation and booking process.
Associate portal: Dashboard, My Leads, My Follow Ups, My Site Visits, My Reservations, My Bookings; manage assigned leads, update status, schedule visits, reserve properties, add remarks.
Admin portal: Manage Projects, Properties, Associates, Leads, Site Visits, Reservations, Bookings, Documents, Gallery, Settings, Reports.
Implement Custom email/password JWT role-based access with temporary demo admin account and object storage for uploads.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include testids like data-testid='...'.
Maintain high-end luxury aesthetic with generous spacing and smooth animations.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use complete transparent background in headers or overlays without blur.
Always use modern button styles with hover interactions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not apply universal transition: all.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs for breathing room.
